cohort: Patients undergoing laparoscopic or robot-assisted laparoscopic hysterectomy, with or without concomitant procedures, between February 2017 and December 2021.
finding: Sugammadex decreases the odds of transient postoperative urinary retention (TPOUR) after laparoscopic hysterectomies compared to the combination of glycopyrrolate and neostigmine (GN).
